example_sentences_in_bangla: ওর কথায় কান দিও না, সে মিথ্যা বলে।
শিক্ষকের উপদেশে কান দাও, তাহলে সফল হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't give ear to his words; he's lying.
Lend an ear to the teacher's advice, and you'll succeed.
note: This idiom is a direct calque of the English 'lend an ear' and is widely used in spoken Bengali.
